name: A World To Come
summary:
A World to Come is a game about exploring all probabilities in an abstract proto-world, rendered in a clean pixel art style. Split yourself across timelines. Materialize from other possibilities. Can you truly reverse an action taken?

Coordinate your environments across all possible results for a solution in any. But be careful - if you become too fractured, you will lose who you are.
